policy: Each exception must name the vulnerability id, package, reason, and a review date. Remove entries when the pin is upgraded or the advisory is withdrawn. New findings without an exception fail the blocking audit gate. Prefer a dedicated dependency-upgrade PR over long-lived ignores.

exceptions.reason: Transitive via optional LiteLLM lock only. Upgrade with litellm profile in a dedicated dependency PR.
Transitive via optional LiteLLM lock only. Upgrade with litellm profile in a dedicated dependency PR.

Reviewed 2026-10-28 against https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g5ff-637f-6q2m and upstream commit 065faf6e695be64a1a367601271839914e4a6621. The affected surface is an authenticated LiteLLM Proxy /utils/transform_request request accepting vertex_ai_credentials. This product invokes only the optional client library completion/acompletion APIs (providers/litellm_sync_backend.py); it does not start/import the Proxy server or expose that endpoint or its SSO/user roles. This short-lived applicability exception is limited to the current client-only deployment, not a fix for affected Proxy deployments. Remove it if a Proxy surface is added or in the dedicated LiteLLM dependency upgrade PR.
Transitive cryptography pin currently locked at 49.0.0 across CLI/GUI/LiteLLM profiles. Upgrade requires regenerating hashed locks in a dedicated dependency PR; not introduced by PR-Agent enablement.
